blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon has asked the public for “a little patience” as authorities prepare for the 49th Asean Summit and make traffic and transportation adjustments for the event. Dizon said the Philippines’ hosting of the regional gathering was a significant opportunity for the country. READ: No general road closures during Asean Summit, says MMDA “This is a great honor for our country,” he said during an interview on Friday. The Philippines is set to host the Asean Summit and related summits from Nov. 16 to Nov. 18. Malacañang earlier declared these dates as non-working holidays in Metro […]...
